title: Chat deletion can permanently remove messages before returning a failure

reviewers: blind AI reviewer, pass 1 (six Claude subagents, one per batch)
aiReview.rationale: The report's sequence holds: deleteChatById and deleteAllChatsByUserId issue the vote, message, stream and chat deletes as separate statements on the root postgres-js handle with no transaction; the catch only rethrows and the FKs have no cascade, so a failure after the message delete leaves the chat without its messages and votes, and nothing restores them.
